title: A noisy-transient borrower's blips never sustain into an escalation
note: Borrower B-000003 is authored so that no signal family ever satisfies T3's persistence test (evaluation.reference_portfolio.cohorts validates this at generation time via persistence_summary). A transient blip must decay back out rather than sustain into a covenant warning or case -- the other half of spec §17.7's zero-false-escalation pass mark, alongside the stable cohort.
